easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn or an opponent's upkeep.
Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Ghostly Flicker.
You control another nontoken artifact, creature, or land.
description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and one other legal target, and putting Ghostly Flicker into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Repeat.
